summary_zh: Oh My Zsh 是开源、社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，提供 300 多个可选插件和 140 多个主题，并自带更新工具，方便跟进社区更新。
audience_zh: 适合使用 zsh 并希望统一管理和扩展终端配置的用户，包括需要插件、主题或自动化安装选项的开发者。

evidence.quote: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,500+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up w
Oh My Zsh is an open source, community-driven framework for managing your [zsh](https://www.zsh.org/)
in your command prompt, you'll take advantage of the hundreds of powerful plugins and beautiful themes.
